name: RejectedObservation
summary: Marks an observation as no longer believed instead of deleting it, so that what was acted upon at the time remains in the record.

roles.name: RejectedObservation
roles.summary: An observation withdrawn after the fact — a mislabelled sample, a transcription error. Figure 3.12 makes it a «dynamic» subtype, which is the whole content: rejection is a state an observation enters, not a kind of thing it was created as. Deleting instead would be the obvious move and the wrong one, because a decision was taken on the strength of it and the record has to be able to say so.
